Task #1151: Require memory header, list bad ones

## Goal

Make wrap-up write the memory-file header Claude Code reads (`name`, `description`, `metadata.type`), and make `list-drift.py` list a file whose header is missing or wrong, so no memory file lands headerless again. Owner approved the finding (https://github.com/kalaluthien/mumu-claude-plugin/issues/1148). Prior work: #433 and #446 (wrap-up merge) and #1094 (memory home); none set a header.

- Cause: `homework/skills/wrap-up/SKILL.md` Domain **Memory file** defines the body lines only, and `references/retro.md` step 5 **Add** names only `confirmed` and `last-confirmed`.
- A bad header is: no frontmatter; a `name` that differs from the file name without `.md`; no `description`; a `metadata.type` that is not `user`, `feedback`, `project` or `reference`.
- Scope: the SKILL.md line, the retro.md **Add** line, `scripts/list-drift.py` with a reader in `homework/lib/memory.py`, and a fixture pool in `homework/skills/wrap-up/fixtures/header-pool/`. `MEMORY.md` is not a memory file and stays unchecked.
- Order: #1149 waits on this task.
